title_en: 43rd Volunteer Infantry Brigade, ready to help the public. They are doing an urgent blood donation for elderly patients at Pattani Hospital.
summary_en: On November 15, 2569 at 10:00 a.m. the Special Operations Unit (SOTU) of the 43rd Ranger Regiment led by Volunteer Officer No. 4305 travelled to Pattani Hospital Blood Bank in Sabaraeng Village, Mueang District, Pattani Province for an urgent blood donation to assist people in the area.

title_en: The Suriyottai Police Command has intensified its operations in the area of responsibility on the Thai-Malaysian border to prevent illegal activities and strengthen security at the border.
summary_en: The Suriyottai Border Control Command, through the 8th and 9th Border Guard Brigades, has deployed troops to conduct a strict surveillance mission along the Thai-Malaysian border in Muno village of Su-ngai Kolok district and Nanak village of Tak Bai district, Narathiwat province, to maintain order and security.
